summary: Agent-defined contract for StayOTA business systems. The business system implements the MCP server (and optional HTTP twin). The Agent is an MCP client and never the source of truth for orders/payments/policies.

roles.agent_local_mcp: Demo-only bridge on Agent /mcp; must not be treated as the production business MCP

transport.secondary: HTTP JSON twin with the same resource semantics

notes: MCP tools may return the envelope JSON as a string or structured content; Agent treats non-OK as a tool failure.
Money, policy, permission and status fields are authoritative; Agent/LLM must not rewrite them.

versioning.compatibility: additive fields ok; renaming/removing fields or changing money semantics requires a new protocol minor/major
versioning.tool_rename: keep previous tool name as alias for at least one Agent release

p1_write_bridge.description: Business write APIs that Agent WRITE tools ultimately call after local gates (confirmation / version / idempotency)
p1_write_bridge.notes: Full Agent tool catalog remains in contracts/tool-contracts.json; P1 only lists writes that need a business system executor.

mcp_tools.name: stayota_get_order_detail
mcp_tools.title: Get authoritative order snapshot
mcp_tools.description: Return the booking-time order facts and optimistic-lock version for the authenticated user.

mcp_tools.name: stayota_list_user_orders
mcp_tools.title: List orders visible to a user
mcp_tools.description: Return only orders the user may view, with masked summary fields.

mcp_tools.name: stayota_get_policy_snapshot
mcp_tools.title: Get booking-time policy snapshot
mcp_tools.description: Return the policy shown at booking time for this order, not the current website policy.

mcp_tools.name: stayota_get_refund_status
mcp_tools.title: Get refund / payment-channel status
mcp_tools.description: Read refund status without translating initiated into received/refunded.

rules: When Mode=Mcp|Http, Agent must not silently fall back to Mock
Prefer exact mcp_tools[].name; aliases_accepted_by_agent are compatibility only
WRITE tools stay behind Agent ToolGateway; business write APIs are P1

out_of_scope_for_business_mcp: Offline Eval and demo workflow runners
Full 33-tool Agent catalog implementation inside business MCP (only P0 reads + P1 write bridges)
